candidates.name: Vankor-Khalmerpayutinskoye Gas Pipeline
aka: Vankor - Khalmerpayutinskoye field trunk gas pipeline

evidence.note: Rosneft release: 30 bcm of gas from the Vankor cluster delivered into the UGSS; the Vankor-Khalmerpayutinskoye trunk gas pipeline is the export route (108 km per other sources).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in the roster by name or endpoints; nearest are Messoyakha-Norilsk and Zapolyarnoye-Novy Urengoy, which are different lines. Length ~108 km comes from search snippets, not the verified page.

candidates.name: Parabel-Kuzbass Gas Pipeline second line (Novokuznetsk)
aka: second line of Parabel-Kuzbass main gas pipeline

evidence.note: Governor proposes bringing forward completion of the second Parabel-Kuzbass line in Novokuznetsk from 2029 to 2027; purpose is to avoid outages during annual maintenance of the existing line. Length and endpoints not given.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Length unknown. May match P2350 / P7615 (Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass I/II) or be a new looping segment; consolidator to decide.

candidates.name: Eastern Gas Supply System (VSG) western section, Yamal-HMAO-Tomsk-Kuzbass-Krasnoyarsk-Irkutsk
candidates.to: Krasnoyarsk, Irkutsk and on to Buryatia

evidence.note: VSG is over 5,000 km through Yamal, HMAO, Tomsk, Kuzbass, Krasnoyarsk and Irkutsk; Belogorsk-Khabarovsk section under construction since 2024; design capacity 28.5 bcm/y.
Government order lists VSG among 13 Gazprom pipelines.
Preliminary surveys underway between compressor stations in HMAO and Tomsk Oblast; no construction timelines.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Likely overlaps P6535 (Volodino-Krasnoyarsk, 700 km, cap 28.5), P0734 and P2376. Western route segments beyond Krasnoyarsk (Krasnoyarsk-Irkutsk) may have no row. Length of the Siberian section is unknown.
